sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 377 was established by Ordinance No. 21529, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 13, 1993. Ordinance No. 21529 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance 21529 was amended by Ordinance No. 23166, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21529; 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 377 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of Old Mill Road and Marsh Lane. The size of PD 377 is approximately 14 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21529; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) The definitions contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) All references to code articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) Section 51A-2.101, “Interpretations,” applies to this article.

(d) For purposes of determining the applicability of regulations in this article triggered by adjacency or proximity to another zoning district, and for purposes of interpreting the DIR and RAR requirements of Division 51A-4.800, this district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use and development on the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 377A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only use permitted on the Property is a church. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 55 feet. Parking may be located in the front yard as shown on the development plan.

(b) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(c) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.45.

(e) Height. Maximum structure height is 80 feet, except for the worship center steeple, which is permitted a maximum height of 140 feet, as shown on the development plan.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent.

(g) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(h) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is four. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Required off-street parking and loading must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 51A for this use and reflected on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.110. LANDSCAPING.

All landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 377B) and completed in accordance with the provisions contained in Article X. All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.112. LIGHTING.

No lighting is permitted for athletic fields. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development and use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23166; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-377.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 377 is located on Zoning Map No. A-6. (Ord. Nos. 21529; 25850)
